title: Isuzu D-Max Price in Kenya 2026: All Your Questions Answered (Single Cab, Double Cab & 4x4)
metaDescription: Get clear answers to all Google questions about Isuzu D-Max in Kenya: 2026 prices, Single Cab vs Double Cab (TFS40 vs TFS87), fuel consumption, and asset financing with Edwin Kibira.

faqs.question: How much is a brand new Isuzu D-Max in Kenya in 2026?
faqs.answer: A brand new Isuzu D-Max in Kenya ranges from Ksh 4,450,000 for the TFR 4x2 Single Cab workhorse up to Ksh 8,900,000 for the top-of-the-range TFS87 3.0L Double Cab 4x4 Automatic (V-Cross / LS-E). Official dealership pricing is available through Edwin Kibira (0768 351 483 / edwin@cfg.co.ke).

faqs.question: What is the difference between Isuzu TFS40 and TFS87 in Kenya?
faqs.answer: The TFS40 features the ultra-economical 1.9L RZ4E Turbo-Diesel engine (150 HP, 350 Nm torque), ideal for high mileage and fuel-conscious fleet operations. The TFS87 is powered by the legendary 3.0L 4JJ3-TCX BluePower engine (190 HP, 450 Nm torque), engineered for heavy towing, extreme off-roading, and executive highway comfort.

faqs.question: What is the actual fuel consumption of the Isuzu D-Max in Kenya?
faqs.answer: The 1.9L D-Max (TFS40/TFR) averages 14.5 to 16.5 km/L on highway driving and 11.5 to 13.0 km/L in city traffic. The 3.0L D-Max (TFS87) averages 12.0 to 14.0 km/L on highways and 9.5 to 11.0 km/L under heavy load or city driving.

faqs.question: Can I get 90% asset financing for an Isuzu D-Max in Kenya?
faqs.answer: Yes. Edwin Kibira partners with Co-op Bank, Equity Bank, NCBA, KCB, Family Bank, and leading SACCOs to offer up to 80%–90% asset financing. Buyers only need a 10% to 20% deposit with flexible repayment terms spanning up to 60 to 72 months.

faqs.question: Is the Single Cab Isuzu D-Max available with 4x4 in Kenya?
faqs.answer: Yes, Isuzu Kenya offers both the TFR87 (4x2 Single Cab) and the TFS87 (4x4 Single Cab), the latter built specifically for challenging rural terrain, tea and coffee estates, farm transport, and telecommunications towers.

title: Isuzu MU-X Price in Kenya 2026: Frequently Asked Questions & Comparison
metaDescription: Comprehensive guide answering all Google search questions about the Isuzu mu-X in Kenya: 1.9L vs 3.0L prices, 7-seater comfort, fuel economy vs Prado/Fortuner, and financing options.

faqs.question: How much is an Isuzu mu-X in Kenya in 2026?
faqs.answer: A brand new Isuzu mu-X in Kenya ranges from Ksh 8,600,000 for the 1.9L LS-U model to Ksh 10,800,000 for the flagship 3.0L LS-T 4x4 7-seater luxury SUV. Contact Edwin Kibira at 0768 351 483 for current stock and customized quotes.

faqs.question: How does the Isuzu mu-X compare to the Toyota Fortuner and Prado in Kenya?
faqs.answer: The Isuzu mu-X offers superior ride comfort due to its 5-link rear coil spring suspension, better standard active safety (ADAS suite), higher fuel efficiency from the 1.9L and 3.0L engines, and significantly lower maintenance costs with comprehensive local dealer warranty.

faqs.question: Is the Isuzu mu-X a true 7-seater suitable for Kenyan families?
faqs.answer: Yes, the mu-X features three full rows of adult-sized seating, dedicated rear roof-mounted air conditioning vents with fan speed control for all 3 rows, and split-folding second and third-row seats for flexible luggage capacity.

faqs.question: What is the fuel economy of the Isuzu mu-X in Kenya?
faqs.answer: The 1.9L mu-X delivers exceptional fuel economy of 13.5 to 15.5 km/L on highways. The 3.0L 4x4 mu-X achieves 11.0 to 13.0 km/L on long distance journeys and 9.5 km/L in city commuting.

title: Isuzu N-Series Trucks in Kenya (NLR, NMR, NPS, NQR 81, NQR Xtra): Specs & Prices
metaDescription: Detailed Q&A answering all Google search queries about Isuzu N-Series trucks in Kenya: NQR 81 and NQR Xtra 4,773cc engines, NMR 85, NLR 2.3T, NPS 4x4, payloads, prices & financing.

faqs.question: What is the exact engine displacement of the Isuzu NQR 81 and NQR Xtra in Kenya?
faqs.answer: The Isuzu NQR 81 and NQR Xtra in Kenya are powered by the 4HL1-TC 4,773cc (4.8-litre) intercooled turbocharged diesel engine, delivering 110 kW (150 HP) and 404 Nm of high-torque pulling power.

faqs.question: How much is an Isuzu NQR 81 and NQR Xtra chassis in Kenya?
faqs.answer: As of 2026, the Isuzu NQR 81 chassis is priced at Ksh 4,775,000 (5.0-tonne payload), while the extended chassis NQR Xtra is priced at Ksh 5,250,000 (6.0-tonne payload). Contact Edwin Kibira at 0768 351 483 for body fabrication packages.

faqs.question: What payload can an Isuzu NMR 85 carry?
faqs.answer: The Isuzu NMR 85 carries a rated 3.5-tonne payload (GVM 5,200 kg) and is powered by the 4JJ1-TCC 2,999cc intercooled turbo engine producing 96 kW (130 HP) and 330 Nm torque.

faqs.question: Is there a 4x4 truck in the Isuzu N-Series for rough terrain?
faqs.answer: Yes, the Isuzu NHP 81H / NPS 81H 4x4 is built specifically for severe off-road conditions, humanitarian relief, drilling support, and remote agriculture, featuring a 3.0-tonne payload and 4,773cc engine.

faqs.question: What body types can be fitted on the Isuzu N-Series chassis?
faqs.answer: Popular body types include High-Sided Cargo Dropside, Insulated Refrigerated Body, Dry Freight Box Body, Steel Dump Tipper, and Water/Fuel Tanker.

title: Isuzu FRR 90, FVR 90 & FVZ 34 Price in Kenya 2026: Specs, Tippers & Payloads
metaDescription: Official guide to Isuzu FRR 90, FVR 90, and FVZ 34 tipper/cargo prices in Kenya: 10T, 14T & 18T payloads, 6HK1 & 4HK1 engines, body fabrication, and bank financing.

faqs.question: How much is an Isuzu FRR 90 in Kenya in 2026?
faqs.answer: A brand new Isuzu FRR 90N chassis starts from approximately Ksh 6,100,000 to Ksh 6,600,000 depending on body specifications. It carries a rated payload of up to 10–11 tonnes with the 4HK1-TCC 5.2L engine.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Isuzu FVR 90 and FVZ 34?
faqs.answer: The Isuzu FVR 90 is a 4x2 heavy-duty truck with a 14-tonne payload powered by a 5.2L or 7.8L engine. The Isuzu FVZ 34 is a 6x4 double-differential heavy-duty chassis (26 Tonnes GVW) powered by the 7.8L 6HK1-TCS engine delivering 280 HP, ideal for 16–18 tonne dump tippers and long-distance cargo.

faqs.question: What is the price of an Isuzu FVZ 34 Tipper in Kenya?
faqs.answer: An Isuzu FVZ 34 6x4 Tipper complete with high-tensile Hardox steel dump body ranges from Ksh 11,800,000 to Ksh 12,500,000, perfect for quarrying, sand harvesting, ballast, and major road construction projects.
